meta.name: get-unpublished-changes
meta.description: Compare HEAD with the latest published npm versions and list all unpublished changes by release layer. Triggers: unpublished changes, changelog, what changed, whats new.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 列出尚未发布的 npm 改动,按发布层级分组。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把本地改动与已发布版本对比,发布前心中有数。
copy.tagline_en: See what changed since the last published npm release.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to review unpublished changes before releasing.

howto.what: 它会比对当前 HEAD 与 npm 上最新已发布的版本，读 diff 而不是照抄 commit，按 omo pure components、omo opencode、omo codex 三层列出未发布的改动，并给出各层与整体的版本号建议。
howto.when: 当你提到 “unpublished changes”“changelog”“what changed” 等词，或想知道发布前积压了哪些改动时触发；它直接输出分析，不反问、不写开场白。

say.text: 看看还没发布的改动有哪些
say.note: 按三个发布层分组列出，并给出版本建议

say.text: 对比 HEAD 和最新发布的 npm 版本
say.note: senpi 相关改动只记入内部排除清单

say.text: 这次改动各层该升 patch 还是 minor？
say.note: 输出分层与整体的版本号建议

howto.what_en: It compares HEAD against the latest published npm versions and lists all unpublished changes by release layer (omo pure components, omo opencode, omo codex), reading diffs to describe the real changes and recommending version bumps.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "unpublished changes", "changelog", "what changed" or want to know what is pending release. It outputs the analysis immediately, with no questions or preamble.

say_en.text: Show me the changes that haven't been published yet
say_en.note: Lists them by the three release layers plus version advice

say_en.text: Diff HEAD against the latest published npm versions
say_en.note: senpi-related commits go only to an internal exclusion ledger

say_en.text: Should each layer get a patch or minor bump?
say_en.note: Returns per-layer and overall version recommendations
